description: Pairs of requests that are semantically equivalent and MUST produce identical cache keys.

pairs.why: Header names are case-insensitive; field order on the wire is irrelevant.
RFC 7230 3.2.2: repeated field lines are equivalent to a comma-joined value (token_list).
Optional whitespace around list commas is insignificant.
Accept-Encoding codings are RFC tokens and case-insensitive; token_set ignores order.
The media TYPE is case-insensitive; no parameters are present here.
raw policy strips leading/trailing OWS but preserves inner content, so both sides are identical after trim.
SP and HTAB are both OWS and are both stripped at element boundaries.
Empty list elements are not values; trailing/stray commas carry no semantics.
Headers outside the allow-list (X-Trace-Id, User-Agent) do not participate.
Commas inside quoted-strings are data; both requests contain the same single quoted element plus token c.
